retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Vink deletes a Document's PDF, what it read and its values once they're no longer needed. The Document's name, dates, history and Delivery log stay.
retention.saved: Saved. It applies from the next daily cleanup.
retention.daysHint: 1 to 365. Counted from the last successful Delivery, from Approval when nothing is sent, or from the last attempt when every Delivery failed.
retention.neverApproved: Documents never approved: 90 days after upload.
retention.rejected: Rejected Documents: 30 days after Reject. They can't be reopened after that.
retention.proposals: Unsaved Form Proposals: 7 days, with their sample PDF.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Every page of a PDF Vink reads counts once, when it's uploaded. Retries and moving a Document to another Form are free.
pages.noneFree: Free pages come once, with the first Organisation someone creates. This Organisation has none, so choose a Plan to upload PDFs.

billing.chooseDescription: Every Plan includes everything. You only choose how many pages. Prices excl. VAT.
billing.custom: More than 3,000 pages a month, or payment by invoice? <contact>Talk to us</contact>.
billing.subscribed: Payment received. Your Plan is ready in a moment.
billing.toppedUp: Payment received. Your extra pages are added in a moment.
billing.failed: Couldn't open the payment page. Try again.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Let a program use Vink without a user: list Forms, send in Documents, read approved data. Read the <link>API reference</link>.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.newDescription: Name it after the program that uses it, so you know which one to revoke later.
apiKeys.notMade: The key wasn't made. Try again.
apiKeys.madeDescription: Copy the key and put it in your program. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
apiKeys.notCopied: Couldn't copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.
apiKeys.onlyOnce: You see this key only now. Vink keeps only a fingerprint of it, so it can't show it again. Lost it? Make a new one and revoke this one.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Programs that use this key get an error from their next request on. Your other keys keep working.
apiKeys.notRevoked: The key wasn't revoked. Try again.
